traits.name: Infused Items
traits.text: A duergar bombardier's items listed as infused last for 24 hours, or until the next time they make their daily preparations.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: alchemist's tools, infused lesser acid flask (2), infused lesser alchemist's fire (2), infused reagents (2), studded leather, warhammer;

traits.name: Alchemical Formulas (1st)
traits.text: lesser acid flask, lesser alchemist's fire, lesser tanglefoot bag.

traits.name: Far Lobber
traits.text: The duergar bombardier has a range increment of 30 feet with their bombs instead of 20 feet.

traits.name: Quick Alchemy
traits.text: ⬻ The duergar bombardier creates a single alchemical item from their formula book (see Alchemical Formulas). This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of the duergar bombardier's next turn.

traits.name: Quick Bomber
traits.text: ⬻ The duergar can use Interact to draw a bomb, then Strike with it.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ bomb +8 (range increment 30 feet, splash); Damage varies by bomb
